text.text_excerpt: I'm pretty sure I ate in a restaurant in this location about a million years ago but it's been a reception hall for the last couple of decades. I definitely attended a wedding here earlier this month. And it was really fun. I liked that there were different spaces to move through from the main room/bar to the atrium to the outdoor courtyard (a little chilly in November but lovely). The food was really good (made in house) and the staff was friendly and helpful. The wedding was held in the courtyard and the party was throughout the space. The bride and groom said they were great to work with and everything was smooth sailing. As an attendee, it was a lovely space to enjoy.

The food, service, location, and just the venue overall are AMAZING. We had our wedding reception at Rosy's. It is very affordable and the alcoholic drinks are amazing. Everyone still comments about the food and drinks (2 months later). We are so thankful for the work that Steve, Darlene, and the entire staff put into making our night special and perfect. Could not have asked for a better venue! P.S. Get a band if you can- the stage is PERFECT for a live band (entertaining and just a unique sound and feel).

The atmosphere of Rosy's is vintage New Orleans, classy and cozy. The rooms are sectioned off to give more of a homey feel than one big room. The bartenders were extremely nice and accommodating. It has an upstairs that overlooks the party and street as well. It is nice to be able to have a little quiet time before you become the host/hostess with the mostest. The food was really good and I loved the presentation of the grilled vegetables. I missed the crayfish beignets but they were the talk of the party. So were the crabcakes and tuna.
